snippet.title: Smokin Potions Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Chaos reigns as up to 4 friends battle in a magical, explosive local-multiplayer showdown. Create your wizard, choose your magical affinity, mix elements, and craft explosive potion bombs to dominate the arena. Even in defeat, haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seizing a second chance at glory.

Wishlist now on Steam!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433720/Smokin_Potions/

Local-multiplayer for 2-4 players, online via Steam Remote Play Together
Explosive pvp combat with mix-and-match elemental potion bombs
Inspired by games like Bomberman 64 battle mode
Each wizard has a unique magical affinity, changing how they interact with the elements
Haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seeking a second chance at victor
